Path Forward: To progress this field of research, HNEI proposes a transparent conductive composite multilayer (TCCM) inorganic/organic multi-layer TCGDB system (Figure 28a). The work expands on the transparent conductive composite (TCC) system concept and the research in multilayer inorganic barriers. The TCCM barrier system is synthesized layer by layer, starting with an inorganic transparent conductive oxide, followed by a TCC coating. Each step is repeated up to 6 times, resulting in the full multilayer barrier system. Our system aims to expand the capability of polymer- interrupted non-conductive inorganic/organic multilayer structures (Figure 28b) by the implementation of conductive particles. The nano/micro-particles allow out-of-plane electrical conductivity and connect to the inorganic conductive layers. With the prospect of optimizing TCC characteristics (e.g., optical transparency, electrical conductivity) and architecture (e.g., number of dyads, TCO properties), our proposed innovation has the potential to facilitate novel encapsulation schemes for the benefit of thin-film photovoltaic and photoelectrochemical devices.
